close_reason: Decision: Option B+ — drop standalone verify_scts helper, put count-returning loop on SctVerifier as verify_embedded_scts. Cleaner than the bead's proposed A (avoids ownership shuffle of CtLogList) and provides what B promised (point users at SctVerifier) without sacrificing the convenience. Cert-embedded SCTs are always precert_entry (RFC 6962 §3.1), so the method takes (leaf, issuer) and dispatches each SCT through verify_sct_for_precert. Returns Ok(count) for per-SCT verification failures (caller checks against policy threshold like CA/B BR §3.2.2.9); reserves Err for input-shape problems (NoScts on missing extension, ParseError on malformed wire bytes). Also retired stale Error variants NoTrustedSct + PrecertEntryNotImplemented (both unreachable after this change). README + CHANGELOG updated. 5 new integration tests under embedded:: mod in tests/verify_precert.rs cover the positive count, empty-logs zero, wrong-issuer zero, no-extension error, and retired-log SCTs zero cases. All workspace dependents (pkix-chain, pkix-chain-simple) build clean.
description:
The crate-level `verify_scts(&Certificate, &CtLogList) -> Result<()>` helper is an unconditional `Err(NoTrustedSct)` stub. PKIX-baac.3 shipped `SctVerifier::verify_sct_for_cert` which actually performs verification, but updating `verify_scts` to dispatch through it requires adding a `SignatureVerifier` generic parameter, which is an API-breaking change (pkix-ct is at 0.0.0 so this is cheap, but it needs a deliberate decision about the helper's exact shape).

## Two reasonable shapes

**A. Generic over the verifier, narrow contract:**

```rust
pub fn verify_scts<V: SignatureVerifier>(
    cert: &Certificate,
    logs: &CtLogList,
    verifier: V,
) -> Result<usize>;  // count of valid SCTs found in cert's extension
```

**B. Drop `verify_scts` entirely and document that callers use `SctVerifier` directly.** Simpler and there is no real value-add over iterating the SCT list yourself.

## Coupling

Implementing this helper meaningfully requires either:
- Stubbing pre-cert handling clearly (PKIX-baac.4 is the real fix for cert-embedded SCTs, which are almost always precert_entry), or
- Documenting that cert-embedded SCTs return `PrecertEntryNotImplemented` until baac.4 lands.

Either way the helper is barely useful for the common 'cert with embedded SCTs' case until baac.4. So this is best done AFTER baac.4 closes.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Decision: keep helper or remove?
- [ ] If kept: signature settled, doc-tested, all existing call sites in tree updated.
- [ ] If removed: `README.md` and crate docs updated to point at `SctVerifier` exclusively.
title: pkix-ct: replace verify_scts stub with SctVerifier-backed helper
